title: Worth building means it forces a decision and gets finished
takeaway: A to-do app forces no decisions and an abandoned hard project reads as not finishing; only the finished, decision-forcing one counts.
sources: A portfolio project is worth building when it forces a decision you can be interviewed about.
Three complete, deployed projects beat twelve half-built ones every time.
If it is not live, it does not count - a repository is a claim, and a running deployment is evidence.
The reason projects die is scope, not difficulty.

cells.note: Nothing to ask about and nothing to see
